chunks: My father narrated to me, from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from al-'Amriki ibn 'Ali al-Bufaki, from Sandal, from Dawud ibn Yazid, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever visits the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) every Friday, Allah will surely forgive him, and he will not leave this world with any regret in his heart, and his dwelling will be in Paradise with al-Husayn ibn 'Ali (peace be upon him). Then he said: O Dawud! Who does not like to be the neighbor of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) in Paradise? I said: Those who do not achieve salvation.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards of visiting Imam Husayn's grave every Friday?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith emphasizes the cumulative spiritual benefit of weekly Friday visitations, promising definitive forgiveness (*al-battah*) and liberation from the regret of death. It underscores the Shia concept of *qurb* (proximity) to the Ahl al-Bayt, linking the physical act of pilgrimage to eternal residence in Jannah alongside Imam al-Husayn, thereby framing Ziyarah as a means of securing ultimate success (*falah*).
